observed_boundary: Probe0026 proved untouched with no active staging shell and intact original pins/UI. Base64 unavailable; no continuation was attempted.
scope: Only change the host-to-SSH input framing. No staging-code, payload, identity/trust, privilege, firmware, package or root command installation change.

approval_modes.inspect_and_resume_if_safe: Fresh portable-capability/ownership probe; reconcile a complete owned stage. Only if untouched and portable-capable, one explicitly authorized printf-framed attempt of the same original code, then the previously approved cutover/UI cycle and conditional prelaunch recovery. Confirms all documents remain saved and closed.
approval_modes.inspect_only: One read-only portable capability/boundary/liveness probe; no mutation.

completed_desktop.prerequisite: Before mutation verify this known new generation/argv, trusted identity and certificate-verified protocol1. No additional host stop/start authorized.

primary_transport_finding.note: Upstream defaults for the observed version are cited. The vendor binary limits were not inspected; do not claim a direct binary measurement.

reads: Current boot/model/firmware, fixed directory identities, original launcher identities, 29 public file hashes/metadata, pinned private config/CA metadata/hash and absent state. No private values returned.
Current Xochitl main PID/start/state; require the unchanged expected running generation for resumable classifications.

Exact stage/release/backup path existence and metadata. Inspect only a root-private known-transaction stage after nonce hash/ownership checks. Return only known phase flags, IDs and payload hashes; never dump journal or arbitrary contents.

Two bounded root-shell marker scans bracketing filesystem inspection, at most 32 root shells per scan. grep -q checks command lines only for this transaction marker or the frozen stage hash; return matching PID counts only. No argument/environment values leave the tablet. No process is stopped.
POSIX printf %b through read -r; 61440-character line/remainder integrity. No external decoder or file writes.
inspection.SSH_debug_privacy: Keep only remote protocol/software-version metadata and sanitized connection errors from verbose stderr. Do not persist agent/key-comment/debug payload dumps.

classifications.untouched: No active staging shell; all original pins/links/private files and expected UI generation intact; exact stage, backup and target absent.
classifications.complete_owned_stage: No active staging shell; exact owner nonce/directory/phase journal and six-file release/rollback link/archive pins prove complete staging; no stop or launch request; original links/private/UI intact. Reconcile, never rerun staging.
classifications.partial_or_foreign: Preserve all state and stop. No cleanup, overwrite or repetition.
classifications.active_staging_process: Observe/block; never duplicate or terminate an active or unknown execution.

portable_stage.requires: Fresh probe exit0, completion marker, untouched and FRAME_CAPABLE=1; no active/foreign/partial state; known desktop ready.
argv:
sh -c 'set -eu
fail() { printf '\''STOP=frame_%s\n'\'' "$1" >&2; exit 41; }
probe=$(printf '\''%b'\'' '\''\0160\0151\0055\0151\0156\0153\0055\0146\0162\0141\0155\0145'\'') || fail printf
[ "$probe" = '\''pi-ink-frame'\'' ] || fail printf
script='\'''\''
for expected in 61440 61440 61440 16620; do
 IFS= read -r encoded || fail prefix
 [ "${#encoded}" = "$expected" ] || fail length
 piece=$(printf '\''%b'\'' "$encoded" || exit 41; printf '\''.'\'') || fail decode
 script="$script${piece%.}"
done
checksum=$(printf '\''%s'\'' "$script" | sha256sum)
[ "${checksum%% *}" = '\''4f65412401b95f2ae09aeea3c58cf9faa814fcb9ebe457c1044527e090d468ae'\'' ] || fail script_hash
exec sh -c "$script"
'

input_framing.algorithm: For each <=12288-byte source chunk, encode each byte as backslash-zero-three-octal-digits, then append one LF. Stream the four bounded prefix buffers, then end stdin with the unchanged raw transport.zip buffer. No ZIP concatenation/copy or all-payload encoding.

portable_stage.decoder: POSIX printf %b. Validate every encoded line length; preserve chunk trailing newlines with a sentinel; hash the exact reconstructed source before exec sh -c. No base64 or Python dependency.

continuation.requires: Explicit inspect-and-resume approval; complete owned stage proved or one framed stage succeeded. No additional desktop mutation.

start_new.requires: Cutover succeeded and its journal/pins remain valid. This is the only explicit new-UI start.

prelaunch_rollback.requires: Explicit separate recovery approval; only after a failed prelaunch operation. Must prove stopped unit, no clients, exact own stage/journal, unchanged private data, no LAUNCH_REQUESTED and known old/new launcher identities.

start_old.requires: Only successful approved prelaunch rollback. No earlier launch request may exist.

continuation.scope: The already approved 0022 programs and exact pinned bytes only; no raw PID signals or new service cycle. The existing one-stop/one-start total caps remain.
continuation.failure: Any failure stops the normal path. Only the separately re-affirmed prelaunch rollback may recover known links; no rollback after LAUNCH_REQUESTED and no credential/state restoration.

validation.summary: Full large-source/raw-ZIP integrity; changed source refused before exec; short frame refused; truncated ZIP refused; exact original staging program reached only its non-root guard on host. No device staging attempt.
validation.syntax: Final read-only probe and compact bootstrap passed sh -n.
validation.actual_UI: Browser/native acceptance is unrun; no invented hardware evidence.

stop_policy: Any uncertain, active, foreign, partial or failed condition blocks. No package install, link cleanup, raw PID signal or private-state restore. No post-launch rollback. Same pre-approved unit stop/start can escalate at90s; preserve staged bytes/backups on failure.
